payload.subject: Sampling, measurement error, ratio counterexamples and optional confidence projection
payload.recommendation: Keep baseline fixed-prediction difference estimator and joint capacity LP. Optional finite-population confidence-set projection is a constructive bridge, not deterministic sharp identification.

claims_for_independent_check.statement: For SRS of fixed size 1<=n<M on equal-duration intervals, no nonconstant fixed predictor uniformly weakly improves HT variance over all admissible labour vectors.
claims_for_independent_check.proof: Take y constant inside [0,d]. HT is constant, variance zero; residual variance of y-f equals variance of f and is positive when f is nonconstant.

claims_for_independent_check.statement: Clipping physically impossible predictions need not lower design variance.
Positive unbiased labour denominator can give biased productivity ratio.

Under fixed finite true y and f and uniform size-n SRS, a two-sided Hoeffding-Serfling labour confidence interval has halfwidth M*R*sqrt(rho*log(2/alpha)/(2*n)), where R=max_m(d_m-f_m)-min_m(-f_m) and rho=1-(n-1)/M if n<=M/2, else (1-n/M)*(1+1/n).
claims_for_independent_check.hypotheses: M>=2, 1<=n<=M, 0<alpha<1, y_m in [0,d_m], fixed finite f_m. Census and R=0 exact. Known valid finite-population residual range, not selected-sample extrema.

claims_for_independent_check.statement: If selected measurements satisfy |ytilde_m-y_m|<=e_m, a valid true-data sampling halfwidth eps extends to eps+sum_s e_m/pi_m for measured-data difference estimator.
claims_for_independent_check.proof: Pointwise estimator difference bounded by weighted errors; triangle inequality on sampling event. Does not give unbiased measured estimator.

claims_for_independent_check.statement: A simultaneous confidence region C_s for true observation vector A x_true yields labour coverage by projecting {x in P0:A x in C_s}.
claims_for_independent_check.proof: On event A x_true in C_s, x_true is feasible, so its labour is in projected extrema. Joint coverage, not independence or marginal coverage, is required.

payload.subject: Keep targets; use same LP for justified error or design-valid confidence regions
payload.formulation: P_s={x in P0:A x in C_s}; if Pr(A x_true in C_s)>=1-alpha, the h-projection covers true labour at least 1-alpha. Polyhedral C_s leaves LP unchanged in class. Rectangular simultaneous intervals can use Bonferroni with total failure probabilities <=alpha, without independence. Empty P_s is a statistical flag possible on failure event, not exact-data contradiction.
payload.ratio: Fixed Q>=0 and H interval with lower>0 needs only reciprocal endpoint inversion. Joint uncertain Q,H requires joint feasible/confidence set; Q=H in [1,2] has ratio1 despite rectangular outer interval[1/2,2]. No extra dependence restrictions may be assumed.
payload.precision: For fixed coefficient beta, Var(Hhat_beta)=V_y-2 beta C+beta^2 V_f. Oracle beta=C/V_f depends on unknown labour; sample-fitted coefficients need new design proof. Frozen prediction, predictor clipping and iid prediction-powered results do not guarantee precision improvements.
payload.measurement: Certified bounded measurement errors can be handled deterministically; sampling and measurement halfwidths add by triangle inequality. Corrected estimator endpoints from sampled measurement intervals bound the hypothetical sample estimator, not H.

note: Independent estimator worker findings from authorised frozen baseline and primary research. Exact rational counterexamples enumerated; published concentration theorem applied with explicit hypotheses. No empirical validation, no formal acceptance, no repository/contract/runtime DB mutation.
